metadata.description: Keeploop for Cursor. The personal context layer for your AI.

plugins.name: keeploop
plugins.description: Your Mac's Mail, Calendar, Messages, Notes, Contacts and Slack in Cursor, through the Keeploop app. You choose what Cursor can see and do.

plugins.name: keeploop-remote
plugins.description: Your Mac's Mail, Calendar, Messages, Notes, Contacts and Slack in Grok Bot, through Keeploop's hosted connector and the Keeploop app on your Mac. You choose what Grok Bot can see and do.
